result.description: SaaS ecommerce platform for merchants: catalog, orders, customers, carts, checkout, storefront and B2B, with REST and GraphQL APIs.
result.auth_detail: Three OAuth-based API account types: store-level (merchant-created token, sent as X-Auth-Token), app-level (OAuth auth-code flow for apps installed from the app marketplace), account-level (works across stores). GraphQL Storefront API also uses customer-impersonation/storefront tokens.
result.access_detail: Store-level credentials are created by any store admin in the control panel (Settings > Store-level API accounts). Developers can get free Partner sandbox stores. Building an app is self-serve in the Developer Portal. Listing in the public App Store needs approval, but a private or single-store connection does not.
result.api_notes: REST Management API (v2/v3) covers catalog, orders, customers, carts, checkouts, shipping, promotions, webhooks, scripts, themes, and more. GraphQL Storefront and Admin APIs are also available. Webhooks supported. Sandbox rate limit 500,000/hr.

evidence.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce's REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.
Merchants generate single-store API credentials when they create API accounts in their store control panel, in the Settings > Store-level API accounts menu.
Sandbox stores are intended for developing and testing apps. They cannot process any live transactions.
To create an account-level API account visit the account control panel or the store control panel for a member store at Settings > Account-level API accounts.
The docs site exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that AI tools can search and reference.
If you're looking for an MCP server that interacts with your storefront, see the BigCommerce MCP Server.
